rev0_regression.method: temporary Rev0 application profile derived from the PlatformIO adapter; current vs upstream sources; no Arduino CLI or hardware

limits: No physical hardware was connected or flashed.
Other host operating systems/toolchain packages were not built.
The optional real-card native fixture and optional JSON-schema test were skipped.
Go compiler tests and a complete Arduino CLI release-staging run were not run.
Simulator comparisons cover deterministic 24-frame samples, not exhaustive gameplay.
